notes: Up to 50 reviews per request keyed r01..r50; definitions are sent once per request in the state. Code then maps answers: sentiment = score/2 - 1; severity rules (praise/request/unclear -> 1, complaint >= 2); evidence quote = full text if <= 280 chars else best keyword sentence; needs_review when a top option < 0.6; post_version post_v2.

topic.access: Login, signup, password or account access problems
topic.usability: Navigation, controls, layout, queue or playlist management, ad interruptions
topic.playback: Playback failure, crashes, lag, connection failures, audio quality, battery or data use
topic.downloads: Downloading, saved music, offline listening, disappearing downloads
topic.catalog: Missing songs or artists, search, discovery, recommendations, lyrics
topic.billing: Price, charges, subscriptions, paywalls, premium entitlement, features or limits locked to premium (e.g. free-tier skip or shuffle limits)
topic.support: Contacting customer support and the support response
topic.other: General praise or criticism with no specific feature, unrelated or meaningless text
topic.rule: If several problems are mentioned, pick the most severe; if tied, the first mentioned. For a positive review pick the first specific praised feature; general praise is other. Mentioning a paid plan alone is not billing.

intent.cancellation: Explicitly leaving, uninstalling, cancelling or threatening to
intent.complaint: Negative experience, including mixed praise and criticism or a generic 'bad app'
intent.request: Asks for a change without reporting a failure
intent.unclear: Meaningless, unrelated, or a bare boycott slogan with no product complaint
intent.rule: If several apply, choose the first in this order: cancellation, complaint, request, praise, unclear.

severity.1: No reported problem: praise, neutral or unclear text, or a pure feature request
severity.2: Dislike, generic criticism, minor annoyance or cosmetic issue; no functional loss
severity.3: A degraded or restricted function; some use or a workaround remains
severity.4: A core task clearly blocked, such as cannot log in or cannot play music
severity.5: Explicit serious financial, privacy or data harm; price, a crash or angry words alone are not enough

r01.severity.instructions: Severity of the problem in `reviews.r01`, using `definitions.severity`.

r01.sentiment.instructions: Overall sentiment of the app review `reviews.r01`

r02.severity.instructions: Severity of the problem in `reviews.r02`, using `definitions.severity`.

r02.sentiment.instructions: Overall sentiment of the app review `reviews.r02`
